feed.title: AI Benefits Database: feed of new and revised cases

entry.title: Police phone app identifies man wanted since 2012 in Cardiff
entry.summary: A South Wales Police officer's OIFR phone app matched a 38-year-old in Cardiff to a 2012 Polish European arrest warrant for drug dealing and assaulting an officer; he was remanded (July 2025).

entry.title: Sky Sentinel AI turret may have downed four Shahed drones
entry.summary: Ukraine's Sky Sentinel, an AI-controlled heavy-machine-gun turret, is reported to have downed four Russian Shahed drones with one prototype; dates and places are withheld (May-June 2025).

entry.title: ASENA flags a car at a Şırnak checkpoint; 86.6 kg of skunk found
entry.summary: Şırnak police stopped a car selected by the ASENA narcotics analysis software; the dog Hector found 86.6 kg of skunk in 119 packages in the trunk, and three lawyers were remanded (March 2025).

entry.title: AI-drafted objection gets a Tokat bus driver's traffic fine annulled
entry.summary: A Tokat school bus driver used ChatGPT to write his objection to a 2,400 TL fine for dropping a student off outside a stop; the court annulled it within three weeks for lack of evidence.

entry.title: Kunshan police AI flags gambling ring and freezes fraud transfers
entry.summary: Kunshan police say their “AI police” models led a 10 September 2024 bust of a mobile gambling ring (20-plus arrests) and froze 500,000 yuan of a 980,000-yuan telecom fraud within 10 minutes.

entry.title: Robot dog checks armed man on Hollywood bus; standoff ends in arrest
entry.summary: LAPD deployed its Boston Dynamics Spot quadruped during a 8 November 2023 standoff with an armed man asleep on a Hollywood Metro bus; he woke, surrendered and was arrested; the gun was a BB gun.

entry.title: An OCT-reading model beats ChatGPT-5 at planning coronary stents
entry.summary: arXiv preprint (11 December 2025): CA-GPT on an AI-OCT system agreed with expert PCI records more than ChatGPT-5 and junior physicians across 96 patients; stent diameter 90.3% vs 72.2% for juniors.

entry.title: Waymo pulls a car over; police find a loaded ghost gun with two minors
entry.summary: LA Times (12 September 2026): before 4 a.m. on 3 Sep Waymo pulled a robotaxi over in the Richmond District after detecting a firearm violation; SFPD found a loaded ghost gun and booked two minors.

entry.title: Huddersfield's first facial recognition vans: three arrests, six checks
entry.summary: Examiner and BBC (17 Aug 2026): two LFR vans in Huddersfield town center over three days led to three arrests and six Sexual Harm Prevention Order stops; the stalking suspect was among those arrested.

entry.title: AI cameras name 18 armed teenagers in Việt Trì within half an hour
entry.summary: Tuổi Trẻ (14 June 2026): on the night of 13 June Phú Thọ police saw a group preparing weapons to fight in Việt Trì; the AI camera system identified all 18 faces in about 30 minutes; all confessed.

entry.title: Ukrainian robots and drones may have taken a Russian position alone
entry.summary: Zelenskyy (13 April 2026): an enemy position was taken “exclusively by unmanned platforms” with no infantry and no losses, per Politico and Business Insider; no location, date or verification.

entry.title: Facial recognition finds a wanted woman in downtown Cuiabá
entry.summary: Diário de Cuiabá (14 July 2025): Sesp-MT's Vigia Mais MT cameras matched a woman with a June 2024 trafficking warrant in central Cuiabá on 12 July; Ciosp tracked her live and the 1st BPM arrested her.

entry.title: A muscle-signal “smart hand” returns daily tasks to Wang Bing
entry.summary: Guangming Daily (13 August 2024): Wang Bing, who lost both hands, uses the institute's algorithm-decoded “smart hand” to eat with a spoon, drink, shake hands, rotate his wrist and write his name.

entry.title: Kota police act on a Meta self-harm flag within a week of tie-up
entry.summary: Kota City SP Amrita Duhan said Meta's red-flag tags for suicidal posts go to a round-the-clock police team; within a week, police prevented a possible suicide by a student from Jhunjhunu (PTI).

entry.title: AI colonoscopy flags a polyp; stage I cancer removed in Chiayi
entry.summary: After a positive fecal occult blood test, Fujifilm AI endoscopy at St. Martin De Porres Hospital, Chiayi, marked a 1 to 1.5 cm adenoma; pathology: stage I colorectal cancer, removed endoscopically.

entry.title: Rekor plate-pattern analysis leads to a Scarsdale drug stop
entry.summary: Westchester County PD's Rekor system flagged David Zayas's driving pattern across 480 cameras; a March 2022 stop in Scarsdale found crack cocaine, cash and a pistol; he was convicted (Carscoops).

entry.title: Instagram self-harm alert brings Satna police to a 17-year-old
entry.summary: 3 November 2022, about 5 pm: Instagram emailed MP cyber police a self-harm alert; Bhopal and Indore teams traced a 17-year-old to Satna in about an hour; she was counseled and sent home.

entry.title: Palantir-based DAR identifies the author of a Siegen amok threat
entry.summary: NRW Interior Ministry, 28 Oct 2022: Palantir-based DAR resolved an amok-threat email against Siegen's city administration in seconds and identified 51 of about 100 people at a Duisburg clan shooting.

entry.title: Xuanwu Hospital implants China's first responsive neurostimulator
entry.summary: 9 Mar 2022: Xuanwu Hospital, Beijing, implanted Epilcure, a closed-loop neurostimulator whose on-skull AI chip monitors EEG and stimulates on predicted seizures, in a man with drug-resistant epilepsy.

entry.title: WeChat Pay reminder stops a 190,000 yuan romance-scam transfer
entry.summary: WeChat says its anti-fraud reminder, with Tencent Cloud online service, led a Yunnan man to cancel a 190,000 yuan transfer to a “goddess” he had met online; reported by ChinaZ, 14 December 2021.

entry.title: Tesla Model 3 steadies a Belgian baker's swerve around a wild boar
entry.summary: Baker Kenneth Van Hoesen swerved around a wild boar at 4 am on 30 May 2020 in Houthalen-Helchteren; he says his Model 3 then took over and straightened the car; Musk replied on Twitter.

entry.title: Rapiscan 3D X-ray CT detects dried marine wildlife at 86–96%
entry.summary: Pirotta et al. (2026) trained 3D CNN algorithms on 298 CT scans: detection 95% shark fin, 96% seahorse, 86% sea cucumber with low false alarms; authors say front-line implementation is the next step.

entry.title: AIMS's ReefScan and ReefCloud automate reef image analysis
entry.summary: AIMS states ReefScan uses machine learning for real-time object classification and ReefCloud automates benthic image analysis; no reef management decision attributed to the AI was found.

entry.title: Transport for NSW trials PAWS wildlife cameras; no results yet
entry.summary: Transport for NSW's Protective Animal Warning System: two AI-enabled roadside cameras on a 13 km Monaro Highway stretch trigger driver warnings; trial announced 18 July 2026, no results yet.

entry.title: VTTI's Route 460 wildlife AI pilot slows drivers 3 mph at signs
entry.summary: One-year VTTI pilot for VDOT on Route 460 near Grundy: AI on thermal feeds triggered warning signs; 97% detection accuracy, 3 mph average slowdown; collisions prevented not established.

entry.title: TrailGuard AI sends tiger alerts within 30 to 42 seconds
entry.summary: BioScience 2023: 12 TrailGuard AI cameras ran in the Kanha-Pench corridor, Madhya Pradesh, mid-May to mid-July 2022 (591 trap nights); tiger notifications arrived 30 to 42 seconds after detection.

entry.title: KWS's FLIR cameras send intrusion alerts at three rhino sites
entry.summary: KWS installed AI-enabled FLIR thermal cameras at three black rhino sites by Sept 2024 (US State Department and WWF funding); intrusion alerts only; no AI-linked arrest or prevented event documented.

entry.title: RFCx Guardian alerts may have stopped logging in Solok
entry.summary: RFCx Guardian sensors detect chainsaws with AI and alert patrols; a 2021 Reuters report from Solok, West Sumatra quotes a patroller that logging stopped. No dated intervention is documented.

entry.title: YES-TECH may speed PMFBY crop-insurance claims
entry.summary: Launched 21 July 2023; nine states by Jan 2025; Madhya Pradesh 100% weightage from kharif 2023. PIB claims faster claims; CSE and DTE report lower payouts and rollback calls in three districts.

entry.title: OCHA uses 510's model as CERF trigger; no activation documented
entry.summary: OCHA frameworks (2021, 2023, 2025) use 510's XGBoost house-damage model as activation trigger; near-activation Dec 2021 (Rai); the Nov 2025 activation for Uwan ran on the 185 km/h wind trigger.

entry.title: RapiD AI-assisted mapping up to 12.4% slower, then disabled
entry.summary: OSM wiki: University of Colorado Boulder/Indiana University research found RapiD AI-assisted contributors up to 12.4% slower; RapiD disabled; OSM data used by AKUT and AFAD. No AI benefit documented.

entry.title: EasyScan GO reaches 91.1% sensitivity for malaria at 11 sites
entry.summary: Das et al. 2022: 2,250 blood films at 11 sites in 11 countries (2018–2019); EasyScan GO sensitivity 91.1%, specificity 75.6% vs expert microscopy; no patient outcome; Global Good funded.

entry.title: GiveDirectly's MobileAid may have halved enrollment cost in Malawi
entry.summary: GiveDirectly posts (2024–2025) describe phone-metadata AI/ML targeting in Malawi: 35% of recipients enrolled via phone data, cost per enrolee halved; no date, count or independent source.

entry.title: Skylight alerts may have led PNA to intercept XINRUN 579
entry.summary: PNA intercepted XINRUN 579 fishing illegally in Argentina's EEZ on 5 January 2025; Skylight says its speed-range and ML fishing alerts prompted the response and a first electronic fine was paid.

entry.title: Google's AEA alerts 16 million+ users to Marmara Ereğlisi quake
entry.summary: AEA detected the 23 April 2025 Mw 6.2 Marmara Ereğlisi quake in 5.31 s and alerted 16 million+ users (median 56 s warning for weak shaking); Google-authored evaluation; inland Take Action shortfall.

entry.title: Amazon Mining Watch maps 496,000 ha of mining in protected areas
entry.summary: AI mining detector (Earth Genome, Amazon Conservation, Pulitzer Center) maps mining scars basin-wide; 496,000 ha in protected areas 2018–2025 reported Apr 2026; no attributable enforcement event.

entry.title: GFW analysts help Indonesia seize MV NIKA; no AI detection
entry.summary: MV NIKA seized by Indonesia 12 July 2019 after INTERPOL tracking with OceanMind and GFW; captain convicted, owner fined, vessel forfeited; no source on file documents an AI detection.

entry.title: UN INSARAG teams in Adıyaman may have used xView2 damage maps
entry.summary: MIT Technology Review (20 February 2023), quoting DIU: xView2 used by two UN INSARAG teams in Adıyaman and by AFAD, World Bank, IFRC and WFP; Microsoft reports 3,849 damaged buildings mapped for AFAD.

entry.title: Turkmenistan repairs at least eight leaks after 192 MARS alerts
entry.summary: Eurasianet (3 September 2026) and The Chemical Engineer (May, Sep 2026), relaying UNEP: 192 MARS alerts to Turkmenistan in a year, about 40 answered, at least eight significant leaks repaired.

entry.title: UNEP MARS alerts lead operators to divert gas from Iraqi flare
entry.summary: The Chemical Engineer (5 May 2026), relaying UNEP: the largest source mitigated in 2026 was an Iraqi flare, 1.7m tCO2e since 2023, apparently in the Zubair field; Eni did not confirm closure.

entry.title: UNEP MARS alert leads to Alberta methane leak repair in a week
entry.summary: Trade press relaying UNEP's August 2026 snapshot: a 175 t/week methane plume at Alberta's Aerial field in April 2026 was traced to a failed ball valve on pigging equipment and repaired within a week.

entry.title: UNEP MARS alert stops Kazakhstan leak; emissions seen again
entry.summary: UNEP IMEO case KAZ_S_136: pipeline leak first detected Sept 2025, operator rerouted gas, mitigation reported 26 Nov 2025, last emissions 12 Mar 2026; subsequent emissions seen as of 21 May 2026.

entry.title: GraphCast may have forecast Lee's landfall nine days ahead
entry.summary: DeepMind says a live GraphCast run on ECMWF's site forecast Lee's Nova Scotia landfall about nine days ahead; NHC records landfall 16 September 2023; no forecaster use of the run is documented.

entry.title: Origin Orbit trial may have found over 800 Thames Water leaks
entry.summary: 18-week Origin Orbit trial on Thames Water's network: over 800 leaks found, est. 8.7 million liters a day saved (utility figures); 13-month contract followed, target 100 million liters a day.

entry.title: IRS applies AI to select large partnerships for examination
entry.summary: IRS (8 September 2023): AI to help detect cheating and select cases; exams planned for 75 partnerships averaging over $10bn in assets. GAO (Jun 2024): two AI models prioritize partnership audits.

entry.title: myTax prompts had an estimated $37 million revenue impact
entry.summary: ATO page: at tax time 2020 nearly 340,000 myTax users (7.5%) got real-time prompts from nearest-neighbor checks; adjustments had an estimated revenue impact of about $37 million.

entry.title: UDK fraud models may have yielded 135, 36 and 72 cases
entry.summary: UDK/ATP ML fraud models (about 60 since 2019): 2023 figures of 135, 36 and 72 cases with revenue from three models; Amnesty (Nov 2024) calls their effectiveness questionable.

entry.title: Foncier innovant finds 140,000 undeclared pools
entry.summary: Minister Cazenave (20 March 2024): DGFiP's AI tool detected 140,000 undeclared pools, c. €40m extra property tax for local authorities; Dordogne found 1,500 in 2023. No commune-level figure found.

entry.title: Corte Constitucional's PretorIA remains in user testing in 2021
entry.summary: PretorIA, presented by the Corte Constitucional on 27 July 2020 to support tutela selection (620,242 tutelas in 2019), was in user-testing in Apr 2021 (Dejusticia); no quantified outcome found.

entry.title: STF's Victor OCR processes 10 million+ pages; classifier pending
entry.summary: STF–UnB Victor: OCR layer live since Dec 2020 (10m+ pages by May 2021); splitter and repercussão geral classifier not yet in production (STF, 19 August 2021); time savings were projections.

entry.title: Alice audit at TCE-MG corrects notices worth R$91.7 million
entry.summary: TCE-MG audit with Alice of 2,297 Aug 2022 tenders: 60 irregularities (R$113,713,128.26); 53 alerts answered; notices corrected worth R$91,723,011.31 (TCE-MG, 27 June 2023).

entry.title: TCU's Alice flags DNIT's BR-153 notices; TCU cancels the tender
entry.summary: Alice flagged DNIT Goiás notices for BR-153 maintenance on concession stretches (R$39m per Inforchannel); TCU Acórdão 1116/2017 canceled the R$20m tender (JOTA).

entry.title: Qualcomm's humanoid may have collapsed safely at Computex
entry.summary: Vendor statement via Creative Bloq (27 July 2026): “The safety systems worked as intended.” NDTV, Asianet and TechSpot describe a face-first or backward collapse; nobody is reported at risk.

entry.title: wi.breathe cameras may have detected a fire start in Troizina
entry.summary: Identical press-release text ran on 12 May 2026 (GOVNews, Newsbeast, Reporter.gr); WINGS's English post omits the detection; the municipality's site has no post on it. No date, place or responder.

entry.title: Ghost Murmur may have found downed F-15E officer
entry.summary: The rescue is official (Ratcliffe, 6 April 2026). The tool rests on two anonymous Post sources; Lockheed declined comment; Trump called it “very important”; physicists say the physics fails.

entry.title: Iron Beam may have made its first combat interception
entry.summary: Ynet and JPost (2 March 2026) call the video unconfirmed; Times of Israel (27 Mar, 30 June 2026) quotes officials that Iron Beam “has not yet been declared operational”. No source on file calls it AI.

entry.title: X-Guard decoy may have diverted Pakistani missiles from IAF jets
entry.summary: Every account traces to ex-USAF pilot Ryan Bodenheimer via idrw.org (6 July 2025). No IAF, MoD, Dassault or Rafael confirmation; CDS Gen Anil Chauhan admitted on 31 May 2025 that India lost jets.

entry.title: ChatGPT's first-aid advice may have saved a teen in Assiut
entry.summary: A Facebook post of 24 May 2025 credits ChatGPT with first aid. Assiut Faculty of Medicine dean Alaa Attia says that the youth had no phosphine symptoms and said he threw the pill into water.

entry.title: Huawei digital twin's window alert comes from a sensor, not AI
entry.summary: A Huawei-hosted launch on 25 Feb 2021 presented a window-opening alert sent to a guard's wristband. Knews and Jiefang Daily say that a window sensor detected it; the story is retold with three dates.

entry.title: Whale Safe ratings support ship slow-downs; cooperation 59–85%
entry.summary: Launched 17 Sep 2020 by UCSB's Benioff lab; grades ships' cooperation with NOAA's 10-knot zones. KCBX: vessels slowed 59% of the time in 2023; BWBS 2024 report: 85% cooperation. No vessel outcome.
